Build an airline from one Saab at Adelaide.
Made from the name. Type to change it

You start at Adelaide Airport with one Saab 340B on the regional bays, and $2,800 in cash. A second Saab is $1,600 in Fleet. The name goes on every aircraft you fly. You can change it later on the Career page.
Build an airline from one Saab at Adelaide.
Each aircraft wears its own fitted design in your fleet colours.
Build an airline from one Saab at Adelaide.
Select your Saab, open Map (Tab) and pick a destination and time.
You earn the fares minus the cost of the flight. Contracts add a bonus.
Leaving on time builds reliability. Late flights and overdue checks cost it.
Finish each tier's goals to unlock bigger aircraft and longer routes.
Coach my first flight step by step
Starting a new airline replaces your saved one.
Plan it, turn it round, watch it go and bring it home.

Select your aircraft (click it or its flight tile, or press [ or ]) and press PLAN FLIGHT, or open the Map with Tab. Pick a green destination and a time, then press PLAN FLIGHT again. Kingscote is a short first hop.
Fuel, catering, bags and boarding happen on their own before it leaves. The aircraft's card shows each one. Press F to follow it as it pushes back, taxis and takes off.
Watch it on the Map while it is away. When it lands, pick a stand on its card. BEST is the shortest taxi. After 90 seconds the tower picks one for you.
The flight is paid the moment it parks. The money goes straight into your funds.
Soak Air moves up a tier.
